cases.comparison: Require reference insecure control and candidate NOERROR with the exact unsigned A response and no AD.
cases.oracle: Independent BIND delv accepts the unsigned child A record without calling it fully validated; the parent delegation NSEC is independently signed.
cases.purpose: An authenticated parent denial of DS at an unsigned delegation returns its answer without AD rather than falsely marking it secure or SERVFAIL.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-insecure-delegation-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> srv.err & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 insecure) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 1 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> resolver.err & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=10 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 unsigned.test A > dig.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re; t=open("dig.out").read(); s=re.search(r"status: (\w+)",t); f=re.search(r";; flags: ([a-z ]+);",t); a=re.findall(r"^\S+\s+\d+\s+IN\s+A\s+(\S+)$",t,re.M); print("insecure=correct" if s and s.group(1)=="NOERROR" and f and "ad" not in f.group(1).split() and a==["192.0.2.77"] else "insecure=incorrect")'
wait "$res" || exit 1
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
